main_results.R2_kernel_lemma: if P.comp L is surjective and finrank W1 equals the rank of L, then P is injective on the range of L and ker (P comp L) = ker L; the consumed form is that P (L z) = 0 implies L z = 0, i.e. on the stratum the differential vanishes along the fibre of the regular component
main_results.R2_dimension_hypothesis_is_necessary: exhibited, not asserted: dropping only that hypothesis, the identity of the plane composed with the first coordinate functional has a surjective composite while the second basis vector lies in the kernel of the composite and not in the kernel of the identity
main_results.R2_uses: no inner product, no measure, no completeness; only V and W1 finite-dimensional, W an arbitrary normed space
main_results.R1_measurability: the rank strata of a C1 differential are measurable, from Mathlib's isOpen_setOfPred_nat_le_rank pulled back along the continuous derivative; needs NO measurable structure on the operator space and NO finite-dimensionality of the target
main_results.R1_decomposition: the critical set is the finite union of the strata of rank below the target dimension; uses NO regularity of u, being pointwise linear algebra
